scope: Recoverable local authoritative writes port adhering to ADR-0003 with single writer exclusivity, bounded state, atomic visible manifest, idempotency, auth-before-idempotency precedence, path containment, provider/header guards, streaming recovery, interrupted/disk-full recovery and negative cases

commands.output: Validated 40 detailed tasks, resources, references and progress; no runtime capability inferred.

Engine and storage tests passed, including single-writer exclusivity, idempotency, interrupted write, disk-full recovery, reference integrity, auth precedence, path traversal guards, corrupted manifest recovery, and all 12 negative cases.
Plan validation, TypeScript check, build, and 29 web/contract tests passed.
VALIDATION PASSED: Checked 130 JSON files and repository contract invariants.

observations: The storage port enforces single-writer process exclusivity using flock and mutex serialization.
Writes are two-phase: staged into temporary files, hash-checked against declared SHA-256, synced, and atomically renamed into immutable blobs.
The state manifest is updated atomically using a versioned generation counter and directory fsync, with client acknowledgement strictly post-commit.
Identity authorization strictly precedes idempotency resolution, ensuring unauthenticated or forged requests cannot probe committed operations or trigger replay outcomes.
Stable operation IDs share the visible transaction; replayed operations return previously committed metadata without duplicating side effects, and parameter conflicts are rejected.
Strict path containment prevents path traversal in operation, case, or evidence identifiers (ErrWidenedPath).
Replayed identity signatures, external/unavailable identity providers, and forged escalation headers fail before any sensitive side effect.
Recovery reconciles orphan staging files left by interrupted writes and performs streaming O(1) memory verification of referential integrity across all committed blobs.
Corrupted manifests and unsupported schema versions fail recovery cleanly with typed ErrCorruptedManifest.
Simulated disk-full and interrupted writes leave visible state unmodified.
Sealed source bytes are strictly immutable and cannot be overwritten.

observed_limitations: The storage adapter is an engine storage port. Aggregates for analyst cases and evidence workflows are introduced in C07.
rollback_or_recovery_observation: Revert the storage adapter and proof documents. Staged temporary files and uncommitted operations leave no persistent state.
